title: Genomic signatures associated with epidemiologically defined high-risk pathogenic Escherichia coli isolates identified by interpretable machine learning.
summary: The study confirms 1,029 isolates, epidemiological EpiHR labeling, RF selection, 10-fold CV, leave-one-group-out analyses and an independent 1,908-genome test; surveillance prioritization is the justified scope.
ai_technology: RF on virulence-associated genomic features; AUC .98/accuracy .93 in CV and independent-test AUC .97/sensitivity .98. Source itself cautions predictions accompany epidemiological information.
